description: Restyle a reference PNG through a selected image generator while preserving labeled text/data regions as exact original pixels.

requires.go: >=1.22 to compile the standalone standard-library PNG helper
requires.shell: POSIX sh, cmp, mktemp, and a SHA-256 utility
requires.image-generator: Caller-selected executable accepting prompt/output/references JSON on stdin and returning a PNG plus JSON provenance; credentials and deadline remain caller-selected
